page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an instance type within the ecs.hfr7 instance family. Built on KVM hypervisor technology and x86_64 architecture, this instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

The ecs.hfr7.12xlarge does not include local NVMe or ephemeral disk storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data needs. Network performance is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to this server instance by default.

With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio paired with an elevated processor clock frequency of 3.3 GHz, the ecs.hfr7.12xlarge balances high memory density with compute capacity. Dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable resource access for core-bound tasks. This hardware profile provides high qualitative resource density for memory-bound applications, enterprise in-memory databases, real-time analytics platforms, and caching infrastructure.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at 3.3 GHz on x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it delivers predictable compute capabilities alongside high clock speeds. The instance carries no local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions, and maintains a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The combination of high memory capacity, dedicated CPU allocation, and elevated base clock frequency makes the ecs.hfr7.12xlarge structured for memory-intensive workloads, enterprise in-memory databases, big data analytics, and large-scale caching engines requiring steady execution without local storage dependencies.
